plaque: Ten thousand candles on one wall, each one a name. The wax runs into a vat at the bottom. The vat is for sale.
vat: The wax vat. A ladle hangs on its rim, and a price list: by the pound, by the name, by the family.
your_candle: A fresh candle near the door, lit. The tag says your name. The tag below it says: odds 3 to 1.
precentor: Precentor Anselma: We sing one verse per flame. Ten thousand flames. We are never done and we are never paid.
Anselma: Maudrey says the Choir is a calling. The Choir says Maudrey is a landlord.
